events.replay_rule: Deduplicate tick/slot identities; interpolate actual stage endpoints only. Absorbing snapshots preserve events and must not replay them.
events.privacy_rule: Source/to/actor/object/value each has its own actual role mask. Active kind-7 bank events publish valid in-bounds bank endpoints and deposited value to every role. The existing public banks entity maps those coordinates to bank_team; actor and geode identities still require their unchanged local identity masks. No hidden geode, underground state or private scan ledger is disclosed.

observation_fields.meaning: Agent-centred patch. Channels: visible, wall, soil, own bank, other bank, paved, depth/2, own-team occupancy, rival occupancy, surface amber count/8, surface teal count/8, carried amber presence, carried teal presence, visible dig event, visible scan event, visible shove event. Out-of-bounds or non-visible channels are zero. Buried deposits never contribute. Event channels use the same conservative returned-state visibility projection as the renderer, so old visibility alone cannot disclose an offscreen new event.

task.objective: Two rival two-person survey crews hunt eight buried geodes. A surveyor can measure counts of amber and teal deposits within a radius but cannot see their exact positions. An excavator opens soil faster. Private scan records can be exchanged only when teammates meet. Once exposed, a geode can be carried, deliberately handed off by dropping it, or knocked loose by a rival's shove. Banking preferred-colour geodes is worth more; the first team to reach eight points wins, with simultaneous finishes resolved from the same new state.
task.natural_termination: After simultaneous deposits, score>=8 gives race ending; otherwise all eight banked ends the game. Compare complete new scores; ties allowed. Otherwise H240 is unresolved truncation.
task.interaction: Several scan origins can constrain a hidden deposit more tightly than one count. Excavation changes later measurements because scans count only still-buried deposits, so timestamps and stale information matter. The surveyor can spend charge on information, while the excavator spends charge to open a suspected tile in one dig. A mistaken rendezvous or stale record can waste both travel and excavation effort. A teammate must physically approach to receive records; that meeting competes with carrying geodes back to bank and gathering new measurements. One agent can expose a deposit while an adjacent teammate picks it up in the same transition because excavation precedes handling. That interaction follows the declared state order rather than an invisible macro action. A dropped geode can be picked by a nearby teammate in the same transition, but simultaneous rival pickup requests cancel, leaving the contested object on the board. A shove can displace a carrier, force a real drop and cancel its pending bank/scan/dig action. Bracing, protected home approaches and shove cooldowns give counterplay. The two teams value colours differently, so visible cargo and public scores change the value of racing, intercepting, handing off or collecting an otherwise lower-value deposit.
task.observation_access: Terrain, base ownership geometry, team/role assignment, scoring rules, total geode count, team scores and total banked count are public. Buried coordinates and colours are engine-only hidden state. Ordinary local visibility never reveals a buried geode. Scan counts and history are private to their record holder. Teammates receive them only through a successful exchange; opponents never receive them. A role sees other agents, their facing/charge/stun/cooldown, surface geodes, carried geode colours and excavation depth only inside its current radius-4 view. No exact position, inventory, depth update, event endpoint or scan readout outside the permitted projection is supplied to an actor or its rendered view. There is no persistent terrain/object memory in the numeric observation other than the six scan records. Policy recurrence may remember past observations; the renderer may not replace unknown current cells with hidden truth. For the role renderer, active bank-event locations and deposited values are deliberately public; match the published endpoint to public bank_xy and read the same-index bank_team. Actor/geode identities keep their local masks. This presentation repair adds no training-observation field.
task.action_mask_semantics: Masks permit attempts whose outcome depends on simultaneous partner/opponent actions. Static bounds/roles/resources are masked; raw transition rules resolve occupancy, new-object availability, adjacency and conflicts. Attempt validity does not guarantee an effect.

reward_definition.formula: Let dS0 and dS1 be new-minus-old public banked scores. Let b=+3 for a new natural team-0 win, -3 for a new natural team-1 win, 0 for a tie, ongoing state or truncation. r0=float32(dS0-dS1+b), r1=-r0. Return [r0,r0,r1,r1].
reward_definition.incentives: No reward for merely scanning, digging, seeing a buried location, shoving, carrying or dropping. Banking is irreversible, so a geode cannot be scored repeatedly.
reward_definition.leakage_control: The only reward-bearing events are deliberately public bank events and public natural outcomes.
reward_definition.horizon: At truncation, retain any banking reward from that transition but do not invent a winner or a terminal win bonus.
reward_definition.empirical_status: No attained reward, victory rate, exploit rate or learned strategy is claimed.

original_design_wording: Apply effective facing changes, then construct four movement intents from old positions.
A target's non-movement effective action is canceled for this transition.
turn_shove_clarification.adopted_interpretation: Facing/turn and movement changes committed in stage 1 remain. Accepted shoves in stages 2/3 cancel only still-pending operations. No turn rollback is performed.
turn_shove_clarification.authoritative_context: The coordinator explicitly confirmed this interpretation in the current source-authoring task before any candidate execution and instructed that mechanism/scene/generation metadata all disclose it.

declared_invariants: These are normative implementation invariants, not tested assertions.
State numerics use int32/bool; observation and reward tensors use float32.
Four agents have distinct in-bounds positions passable for their own teams; no opponent can occupy a protected base cell.
Exactly eight geodes exist, with four of each colour. Each is in exactly one status. Banked status is irreversible.
Every carried geode has exactly one carrier and reciprocal agent_cargo link; every agent carries at most one; all non-carried geode_carrier entries are -1.
Carried coordinates equal carrier coordinates; banked coordinates are [-1,-1]. Surface stacks are allowed but initial buried cells are unique.
A buried geode's soil depth is less than 2; reaching depth 2 exposes it. Digging never regenerates a buried geode.
Charge remains 0..8, stun 0..1, cooldown 0..2, soil depth 0..2, and public scores 0..16.
Each valid private record is an immutable measurement of one completed scan; exchange preserves origin, counts and tick. A ledger contains at most six unique identities.
Raw scan counts, buried coordinates and unfiltered events never enter another role's observations or render frame.

At most 40 events are needed: at most four primary action events, four newly exposed geodes, four forced drops and one ending event form a conservative 13-event bound. Implementers must verify capacity instead of silently truncating.
done=terminated OR truncated, never both; natural outcomes take priority at the time limit; unresolved truncation is not labelled victory.
No action ordering chooses a pickup, move or shove winner by lower agent id. Lowest geode id is only a documented selection among already-visible co-located objects.
Ended raw states absorb with zero reward and no repeated animation events.

render.role_view: Use all actual visibility and event component masks before constructing the role frame. Public bank endpoints and values do not grant actor/geode identity; team comes from the public banks entity.
render.debug_view_label: DEBUG FULL STATE — engine-only underground/private information
render.event_playback: Events are last-transition evidence with tick/slot identity. No invented paths or repeated effects on absorbing calls.
render.visual_requirement: Render actual spatial board, moving agents and interactive objects. Numeric panels only supplement gameplay.
